verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a mobile app for GitHub collaboration: reviewing PRs, triaging issues, notifications and Copilot agent tasks. It is not a terminal or SSH client, so generating SSH key pairs for password-less access to your own servers is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any SSH key-generation capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can generate SSH key pairs for password-less access to my servers
